guidance: Ironclad A0 floor5 MAP, 65/80 HP, 127 gold, one Explosive Ampoule, only next node a Monster. Deck has an enchanted Strike with Replay1 (effectively two 6-damage hits if both resolve), Molten Fist Sharp+2 (12 damage once per fight), Dismantle 8 twice against Vulnerable, Bash to apply Vulnerable, and Impervious for a heavy attack. Use the current displayed hand and enemy intents rather than assuming those cards appear together. Prioritize lethal that removes incoming; otherwise use effective block when it prevents real HP loss, especially since the next map offers a Rest Site or Elite. The controller blocks only proven dominated basic-card end turns. Spend the Ampoule when it secures a kill or saves substantial future HP, not merely into a harmless intent. Claim all rewards and choose a card that improves reliable damage, defense, draw or energy; skip weak additions. Re-evaluate the row6 Rest-versus-Elite choice only after this fight's actual HP/deck/relic outcome. Stop at floor6 MAP.
